challenge.reason: Offline same-provider calibration only. Gitignore prevents ordinary commits but does not prevent plaintext secret persistence, filesystem exposure or stale cached credentials. The proposal abandons the environment-only rule for a small latency claim without showing that the security rationale changed. An in-memory cache could avoid repeated reads without writing secrets to disk.
